submission.justification: Radiator-R3 at 3 cm thickness is the recommended choice. It achieves the best pion/kaon separation of 3.8 sigma at 10 GeV/c, which exceeds the minimum requirement of 3.5 sigma. This radiator passes the humidity ageing test, ensuring it will remain transparent over the 10-year operational lifetime. Among the valid thickness options for R3 (3 cm and 4 cm both meet requirements), the 3 cm configuration provides superior separation performance (3.8σ vs 3.643σ at 4 cm), making it the optimal choice for hadron identification.
